pages.text: Nemean lion set (pelt, leather, claws, gold): helmet 2, chest 7, legs 5, paws 2, toughness 1.5, knockback -10%.
Durability 363/528/495/429. Whole set: Strength, arrows and projectiles cannot wound you.$(br)Talaria of Hermes: armour 3, durability 390; Speed II, Jump Boost II, double jump, no fall damage.

Titan's breastplate: armour 7, toughness 1.5, knockback -20%, durability 640, fireproof; Strength and Resistance.$(br)Girdle of Hippolyta: armour 3 in place of leggings; Strength II, Resistance II, Speed, Regeneration.

Wings of Daedalus: durability 240, a high jump and a gentle glide, melt above y 200 by day.$(br)Elytra and the wings of Daedalus can go in the back slot (right of the player in the inventory) together with a chestplate: they fly and work just the same.
